0x000792.en: 「Th-this is as far as I go...!」

0x0007C4.en: 「With the skill I have now...@　this is my limit...!」

0x000835.en: 「Guh! @　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x0008BD.en: 「Damn it! @　Next time you won't get me!」

0x0009E6.en: 「Is this as far as I get...!?」

0x000A1E.en: 「Oh dear... @　how uncool of me, honestly!」

0x000AE7.en: 「Ngh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x000B22.en: 「No way I'm botching it here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000B76.en: 「Botched it...!@　Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000BEA.en: 「Guh! I've got no choice but to fall back!!」

0x000C60.en: 「So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000CC7.en: 「This is my limit... the rest is yours.」

0x000CF9.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is where it ends!」

0x000D73.en: 「It's no good, took too many hits... I'm retreating!」

0x000DC0.en: 「I'm beaten. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000DFE.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you all!」

0x000E45.en: 「To think... the Granzon would be shot down...」

0x000EF0.en: 「Ngh... to think I'd become a shooting star... I'm ejecting!」

0x000FA7.en: 「Owowow... I give. A miscalculation on my part.」

0x000FE8.en: 「Well shoot, they went and got me!」

0x00102C.en: 「Ngh...! So this is where it ends...!」

0x001099.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0010E0.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x001115.en: 「Damn it! Is this all the strength I've got...!?」

0x001201.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@　I'm still too green...!」

0x00124F.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Falling back!」

0x001339.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001377.en: 「Well, well. So this is the end.」

0x0013A6.en: 「I can't go on. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x001431.en: 「Was I careless...?@　I'll pull back here...!」

0x001597.en: 「Ejecting now...@　Ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x001655.en: 「Grrgh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0018E9.en: Holy Kingdom of Langran - Langran State - Royal Capital

0x001951.en: 「...The unit sent to Troia wasn't meant@　to seal off the Volkruss temple@　on Mt. Grimold after all.」

0x0019E4.en: 「Then it was to press on and@　invade Shutedonias directly...?」

0x001A3A.en: 「Yes.@　And my brother means to take his own unit@　to Nagol Bay in Baldia.」

0x001AC4.en: 「Langran hardly looks ready to wage@　an all-out war with Shutedonias right now...」

0x001B47.en: 「...You're right. There are still Kirkus@　remnants who haven't surrendered, and@　the chaos across Langran hasn't settled.」

0x001BEC.en: 「Naturally Shutedonias will retaliate...@　and Kirkus himself, still on the run, might@　make a move amid the confusion.」

0x001C9D.en: 「And if Louzorl and his lot get involved,@ we could get blindsided.」

0x001CFF.en: 「I don't know what happened, but His Highness is@　too hasty. Striking Shutedonias now helps no one.」

0x001D9A.en: 「If the Langran army were unified, fine...@　but as it is, the enemy could pry at the cracks@　and the whole thing could collapse.」

0x001E4E.en: 「I wonder what he thinks his odds are, or where@　he sees this going.」

0x001E9A.en: 「Could it be that Prince Feil-Lord means to force@　a quick, decisive war with Shutedonias using@　elite units like Duraxil and the Machine Gods?」

0x001F98.en: 「And if our forces are counted@　among them as well...」

0x001FF1.en: 「Masaki, did Prince Feil-Lord say anything@　about what he means to do with us?」

0x002066.en: 「He said he'd answer our request@　later, but...」

0x0020DB.en: 「Captain, incoming transmission from His Majesty@　Feil-Lord. He requests the Machine God pilots attend as well.」

0x0021B2.en: 「...Masaki, Tytti,@　sorry for the delay in reaching you.」

0x00222D.en: 「I know your objections.@　But this has already been decided.」

0x002298.en: 「Do you truly wish for@　war with Shutedonias?」

0x0022FA.en: 「Yes. Through all these battles, I've come to see it.@　Any further conflict can only be ended by@　uniting all of <La Gias> under one banner.」

0x0023BC.en: 「Langran's falling apart as it is.@　Fight Shutedonias in that state and@　we'll be the ones to buckle first.」

0x002467.en: 「I know that, Masaki.@　But their distrust of us is only growing.」

0x0024DE.en: 「They'll gather strength and invade us again.@　By then it's too late. Now, with Shutedonias@　pulled back, is the perfect moment.」

0x002598.en: 「So I'd like to borrow the power of your@　<Machine Gods> and <Elemental Lords>.」

0x0025FB.en: (Just as I thought... he means to strike the enemy's heart with a lightning offensive...)

0x00264A.en: 「...As a Machine God pilot,@　I can't accept that request.」

0x0026A3.en: 「Why? Because your way of doing this...@　a war with Shutedonias won't bring@　peace to La Gias. That's why.」

0x002745.en: 「Masaki, no clever half-measure will@　bring true peace. What's needed is fundamental reform.」

0x0027C5.en: 「Solving everything by force is the talk@　of a second-rate politician. You planning to@　become a second Kirkus?」

0x00286A.en: 「...Perhaps you're right.@　But I'll walk the path I believe in.」

0x0028C6.en: 「History may one day call this an atrocity...@ but I won't let fear stop me.@ All I can do is what's within my reach, now.」

0x00298F.en: 「...Brother, what's driving you so hard?@　And what's the basis for this decision?@　Could it be... Duraxil?」

0x002A2B.en: 「I don't imagine a single Elemental Lord can@　turn the tide of war. But this moment is the only@　time I can accomplish anything great.」

0x002ADF.en: 「Even if it drags not just Langran but all of@　La Gias into the flames of war?」

0x002B53.en: 「Yes. La Gias needs overwhelming power@ and deterrence now... unless someone acts as@ strong medicine, the fighting won't end.」

0x002C0A.en: 「So I want you to take the wider view@　and stand with my decision.」

0x002C7B.en: 「Something's wrong... this is wrong, Prince Feil-Lord.@　When did you become like this?@　Why do you crave power so badly?」

0x002D38.en: 「What I want in the end isn't power...@　it's the order to bring peace to La Gias.」

0x002DBE.en: 「It's the way you'd get it that I've got a problem with.@　So I won't lend you my strength now.@　I'm pulling out.」

0x002E63.en: 「Tytti, Mio... you two feel the same?」

0x002E9D.en: 「I'm with Masaki...@　Digging up a war that's finally@　about to end...」

0x002F40.en: 「Understood... I won't force you.@　...And, Lt. Colonel Tetsuya Onodera.」

0x002FBB.en: 「The day after tomorrow, preparations for your surface@　return will be ready at Seb Temple. Head there.」

0x003057.en: 「And once more, I offer my thanks@　for all the aid you've given us.@　Farewell.」

0x00312B.en: 「Dammit, why did it come to this...!」

0x003190.en: 「Don't ask me, I don't have the answer...!」

0x0031F8.en: 「Either way, let's guide the Hagane to Seb Temple.@　We can't drag anyone else into this.」

0x0032A0.en: 「...Though turning back here doesn't sit right with me.」

0x0032EC.en: 「Yeah...@ Knowing it'll turn into a slugfest and just looking the other way...」

0x003351.en: 「But isn't this the place to bow out?@　His Majesty Feil didn't ask for our help, after all.」

0x0033D7.en: 「But someone has to stop him...@　or everything Masaki and the others did means nothing.」

0x00347C.en: 「...From the times I've spoken with@　His Majesty Feil-Lord, my read is that@　he's not a man who jumps to rash conclusions.」

0x003524.en: 「And a sudden show of force breeds fierce backlash.@　Just as we stood against Bian Zoldark@　during the <DC War>.」

0x0035D4.en: 「His Majesty Feil-Lord must know that too.@　That he's rushing regardless means@　he may have some reason of his own.」

0x00369D.en: 「Personally, I'd like to know it.@　Odd fate or not, we fought side by side.」

0x003705.en: 「The reason for the Prince's change of heart...」

0x003733.en: 「But we have duty on the surface.@ We must return home with the Hiryu Kai.@ Sorry, Masaki... can you guide us to Seb Temple?」

0x0038FF.en: 「Meeting you here must be some kind of fate.@　Allow me to keep you company for a while.」

0x00397C.en: 「Tch, of all times! Captain, I'm launching!」

0x0039BC.en: 「...Let me ask you one thing.@　Why is it you won't join@　His Majesty Feil-Lord's forces?」

0x003A4C.en: 「I've got no reason to tell the likes of you!」

0x003A8C.en: 「Is that so...@　Well, if you won't join Feil's army,@　that suits me just fine.」

0x003B44.en: 「If Langran and Shutedonias clash@　with forces that lack a decisive edge,@　they'll soon fall into stalemate.」

0x003BE0.en: 「And that will bring still more chaos to Langran...@　making it easier for us to move.」

0x003C67.en: 「In other words, one might say His Majesty@　Feil-Lord's actions are indirectly@　aiding Lord Volkruss's revival.」

0x003D2E.en: 「If no one can stop His Majesty, all the better.@　In the end, the day of our dearest wish draws nearer.」

0x003DB7.en: 「Now then, shall we begin?@　I'd like to thin out the nuisances, even a little.」

0x003E1C.en: 「Shut up!@　You're the one who came to get in our way!」

0x003E72.en: (...Merging the surface army with theirs would put@　General Kirkus at a disadvantage.@　I'd best delay them here.)

0x003F1A.en: 「...Well, that should about do it.@　Lord Randall, let us meet again somewhere.」

0x003FC2.en: 「Don't chase too far here, Masaki!@　Let's take down the rest of the Demon Golem!」

0x0040E8.en: 「Good. Maintain strict air and ground watch.@　Bring all units back aboard.」

0x00414B.en: 「...The very thing we feared has come to pass.」

0x004198.en: 「Yes. Louzorl saw the current situation@　as an opportunity.」

0x0041F4.en: 「This time it was just Demon Golem, but@　if those had been avatars of Volkruss...」

0x004268.en: 「...I hate to admit it, but@　Louzorl's got a point.」

0x0042D4.en: 「Prince Feil's actions are a wellspring of chaos.@　And there are those who'll exploit it...」

0x00435A.en: 「Not just Louzorl. Worst case, Kirkus too.@　We've got to stop the Prince now after all.」

0x00440F.en: 「His Majesty Feil is leading his unit@　toward Nagol Bay, right?」

0x004480.en: 「I'll chase him down with Cybuster now.@　And I'll try talking to him... one more time.」

0x0044F1.en: 「And if the other side still won't back down,@　what do you plan to do then?」

0x004550.en: 「If it comes to that... I'll stop His Highness by force if I have to.」

0x0045DA.en: 「Yeah. When the world's at stake, cast it all@ aside and fight... Prince Feil himself taught me@ a Machine God pilot's duty.」

0x0046A3.en: 「...If that's how it is, then I'm coming too.@　Not to fight His Highness, though...@　but to talk him down and stop this war.」

0x00476A.en: 「I'm coming too. I think there's still time.」

0x0047A7.en: 「Xenia, I need you to stay aboard the Hagane@　and head for the Seb Temple.」

0x00480C.en: 「No, I'm coming with you.@　I think my brother's wrong about this...@　and I want to know why he changed his mind...」

0x0048B1.en: 「Lord Masaki, I shall accompany you as well.」

0x0048FE.en: 「I'm coming too, big brother.@　Just like Mio said, I think we can still@　stop His Highness...」

0x00499E.en: 「...You mean to go on your own?」

0x0049D8.en: 「Yeah... This is our problem to deal with.」

0x004A5C.en: 「All of you have finally earned the chance@　to return to the surface.@　We can't burden you any further than...」

0x004AEC.en: 「Transfer's not ready till the day after tomorrow,@ so we've got time. Maybe there's more we can do@ before heading back to the surface...」

0x004BA0.en: 「That's how I see it.@　We fought to bring peace to Langran, even if only@　for a little while.」

0x004C33.en: 「And now that we've gotten involved in this world's affairs,@　I think we have a duty to see it through to the end.」

0x004CD5.en: 「They say a bird leaves no mess behind.@　I'm with the Captain on this one.」

0x004D2E.en: 「Well, we're already in it up to our necks.」

0x004D6F.en: 「...I figured you'd be the first to object.」

0x004DB2.en: 「I've been through something like this before...@　Though I wasn't there when it happened,@　and I couldn't stop it with my own hands.」

0x004EC2.en: 「I think further interference is dangerous, but...@　if our presence works as a deterrent,@　then I suppose there's no helping it.」

0x004F4C.en: 「I won't force anyone on this. I'll give each of you@　time to decide. Think it over carefully.」
